title: Betagro Shop weekly price list
description: Output of any extractor (Claude, Benny, a human). One file per price week.

effective_date.description: Same as valid_from. Names the file data/prices/<effective_date>.json.

valid_from.description: First day the prices apply (YYYY-MM-DD, Gregorian)

valid_to.description: Last day the prices apply, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD, Gregorian)

source_file.description: File name(s) of the PDF/image the prices came from

qty_unit.description: Unit for both min_qty/max_qty and the price (baht per kg / tray / pack)

tiers.description: Quantity breaks, ascending by min_qty. Only columns that have a number on the sheet.

min_qty.description: Order quantity from which this price applies

max_qty.description: Optional upper bound, inclusive. Omit on the last tier (open-ended).
